validations.details: Canonical object model package completed without implementation code changes.
Evidence architecture package defines source authority, provenance, confidence, conflict, explainability, and traceability without ingestion, storage, connectors, or APIs.
Semantic relationship package defines relationship ontology, temporal evolution, inference classes, graph governance, cross-domain bridges, and validation without storage, inference engines, or APIs.

Business Genome foundation freeze certifies the canonical object, evidence, and relationship packages as the frozen semantic baseline without implementation, runtime, API, storage, or connector changes.
